hero.title: Axopar 45 Cross Top
hero.heading: Axopar 45 Cross Top
hero.subheading: Supreme Comfort & Performance. Redefining Adventures & Days at Sea.
hero.intro:
The Axopar 45 Cross Top is a hybrid of the Sun Top and Cross Cabin models, combining the best features of open and enclosed boating. Its negative-angle wraparound windshield protects against wind, rain, and glare while offering all-around visibility and improved navigation capabilities - an ultimate choice for professionals and seasoned adventurers. 

With its unparalleled drivability and unique features onboard, you have more reasons than ever to head out longer and explore further - whatever the weather. The boat's renowned hydrodynamics, not only in fuel efficiency but also in ride dynamics, give you the sporty feel of a much smaller boat.

sections.title: The Best of Open & Enclosed Boating
sections.intro: The Axopar 45 Cross Top is a hybrid of the Sun Top and Cross Cabin models, combining the best features of open and enclosed boating.

items.name: Gullwing Doors
items.title: Gullwing Doors
items.text: The modern-day icons are standard on the 45-range. Forget cramped front cabins with little light; transform your already airy front cabin by opening the gullwing doors and letting the elements in.

items.name: Balcony Doors
items.title: Balcony doors
items.text: Driven by a usability and safety perspective, we chose to locate an innovative new solution, our raised balcony doors, amidships, where all the social activity is centered on the boat, extending usable seating space without sacrificing safety or comfort onboard.

items.name: Protected Helm
items.title: Protected Helm
items.text: For those longing to explore further or enjoy longer days out at sea, the wrap-around, negative-angle windshield not only shelters the front row from wind chill and spray but also reduces glare and droplet buildup on the glass.

items.name: For Sociable Moments
items.title: For Sociable Moments
items.text: Stepping onboard the Axopar 45, the large social areas will capture the attention right away. With five massive social spaces on the boat – the fore deck, helm, cockpit, including the balcony doors, aft deck, and the front lounge with the gullwing doors – the sense of spaciousness is simply undeniable. In the cockpit, the wraparound sofa around the wetbar provides additional seating for dinner guests.

sections.title: Best Drivers Experience
sections.intro: Axopar 45 is one of the most economical 45-footers on the market. Powered by triple Mercury V8 300 Verado engines, the Axopar 45 can cruise at speeds between 19 and 35 knots while remaining in the most cost-effective range. The advanced infusion lamination method used to manufacture hull and stringer systems results in a lighter and more fuel-efficient boat.

items.name: Drivers Experience
items.title: Drivers Experience
items.text: The bow thruster, trim tabs, and audio system have never been closer. The intelligent steering module gives you control over all of these from the steering wheel.

items.name: Navigation Upgrade Package
items.title: Navigation Upgrade Package
items.text: The adventure just got bigger, so why not opt for the bigger, 16" Simrad NSS MFD's, with Axopar user interface integrated, a fully customized, innovative and driver focused user interface with integrated vessel startup check, eco/sport driving modes with active driving assistant features as well as entertainment and media control with all controlled and monitored via the intuitive single-touch glass display.

items.name: Outstanding Drivability
items.title: Outstanding Drivability
items.text: Although it's larger in size, the 45 feels just like driving the sporty Axopar 37. It keeps the same nimble, agile, and best-in-class driving experience that defines a true Axopar. With excellent visibility from the helm and its ability to maintain average speeds of up to 40 knots in confused sea states or choppy wave conditions, it shows quite remarkable figures for a boat of its size. Many rivals need 3 x 450 or 4 x 300 hp engines to match the Axopar 45’s top speed of +50 knots with 3 x 300 hp V8 Mercury Verado.

sections.title: Family & Friends Comfort
sections.intro: Designed for unforgettable moments with family and friends, the Axopar 45 Cross Top offers everything you need for shared comfort and enjoyment.

items.name: Wet Bar
items.title: Wet Bar
items.text: To make the most of the 45 pilothouse's layout, we decided to create a Wet Bar with a center sofa and a leaning post, turning it into a new, innovative, and functional centerpiece of the pilothouse.

items.name: U-Sofa on Aft Deck
items.title: U-sofa on Aft Deck
items.text: The stylish U-sofa layout on the aft deck boasts comfortable seats and headrests for sitting back and relaxing. Compartments under the U-sofa’s longitudinal benches and transversal bench provide ample dry storage space with easy access. This option also includes an infill cushion that can transform the U-Sofa into a luxurious full-size sun bed.

items.name: Travel Edition
items.title: Travel Edition Alternative
items.text:
Adventurers looking for another level of comfort and storage space during their weekend or long-distance travels will like this new Travel Edition.

The Travel Edition includes:
• A modified bed: the foldable sofa is replaced with a permanent bed, two-drawer storage, and two smaller storage underneath.
• The port-side sofa is replaced with a storage cabinet.

items.name: Enclosed Head & Shower
items.title: Enclosed Head & Shower Compartment will Full Standing Height
items.text: A redesigned layout creates a bathroom that's 60% larger, with a separate shower area for enhanced comfort and practicality. Increased headroom, thanks to the new GRP design, further elevates the onboard experience, while generous storage solutions keep personal belongings neatly out of sight.

items.name: Aft Cabin
items.title: Extend your adventures with the Aft Cabin
items.text: If you want to go further and stay out longer, while bringing more guests, opt for the optional Aft Cabin, which comfortably accommodates two people and has plenty of storage/space for an additional head compartment.

items.name: Wet Bar in Fender Box
items.title: Integrated Wet Bar in fenderbox
items.text: Axopar, fuelled by a passion for innovation, has introduced technical features to enhance the aft deck’s usability. The optional integrated starboard fender box’s grill run by shore power or an optional power bank will make any meal onboard an instant hit, and the 40L fridge ensures cold drinks and snacks are within arm’s reach. A sink with a faucet and storage compartment underneath adds further convenience to life on deck.

sections.title: Welcome to the Hull of Fame
sections.intro:
Every Axopar begins where the boating experience truly begins: below the waterline. Many boaters have learned to accept certain compromises as normal. Our hull-first approach gets the fundamentals right from the start. Since the first Axopar 28 was launched in 2014, this philosophy has shaped our multi-award-winning range, helped create the adventure boating category, and contributed to more than 7,600 Axopar boats being sold worldwide.

Discover the Hull of Fame and the engineering behind the distinctive Axopar driving experience.

items.caption: The Cross Top creates a protected driving environment with its wrap‑around, negative‑angle windscreen. It cuts wind chill and spray, improves visibility, and reduces glare and droplet buildup for a clearer view in all conditions.

The spacious cockpit layout brings people together with generous seating, open movement, and clear sightlines across the boat. Whether cruising, anchoring, or hosting guests, the cockpit offers a welcoming space for long days on the water.

The helm is shaped for confident control in all conditions. A wide dashboard, ergonomic controls, and excellent visibility support relaxed, focused driving. Combined with the smooth, balanced hull, it creates a commanding yet comfortable experience on every journey.

The aft U-sofa forms a natural gathering point right at the water’s edge. The cushions and wraparound layout make it ideal for dining, sunbathing, or enjoying time at anchor. The generous aft deck and easy access to the water elevate both comfort and usability.

Every space on the Cross Top is designed to feel bright, spacious, and calm. High-quality materials, refined ergonomics, and smart storage solutions create a practical and comfortable environment for longer adventures. The result is a versatile boat built for extended days onboard.

sections.title: Upgrade Options
sections.intro: Elevate your Axopar 45 with the stylish BRABUS Line for a refined, premium look and feel — or choose the BRABUS Performance Line for extra power and exhilarating speed. For those who value ultimate comfort, the Mediterrana Edition and Marine Decking create a luxurious onboard experience, perfect for lounging and entertaining.

items.title: BRABUS Line
modal_text:
The BRABUS Line Option consists of:

Steering wheel set BRABUS (ISM) with Audio and trim tab controls

Handrailing on gullwing doors and console hatch in BRABUS black leather

Cleats, black with BRABUS logo

Map pockets, BRABUS Line

Mast, black

Mast base, black

Carbon monoxide sensors, black

3D Logo on hull, titanium black

Smoke detector, black

Handrails around deck, black

items.title: BRABUS Line Color Edition
modal_text: For style-conscious customers looking to make their Axopar 45 truly stand out, the Brabus Line Color Edition introduces four striking hull colors: the vibrant, playful Miami Blue; the more subtle, sophisticated Platinum Grey. The fresh, contemporary Glacier Blue; and the timeless, elegant Pearl White.

items.title: BRABUS Performance Line
modal_text: Axopar 45 Cross Top Brabus Performance Line

This premium option delivers a dynamic combination of enhanced aesthetics and boosted performance, powered by triple Mercury Verado V10-350 engines, for the ultimate boating experience. Designed to meet the demands of those who seek a superior boating experience, the BRABUS Performance Line fuses cutting-edge design with powerful performance.

items.title: The Mediterrana Edition
modal_text: Designed for those who enjoy lounging, socializing, or cruising in the sun, the Mediterrana Edition enhances onboard comfort and sophistication without compromising functionality. Luxurious features include thicker, plush, more refined cushions in a sophisticated beige tone. The upholstery’s structured texture and patterns not only exude style but also keep lounging areas cool and comfortable, even on the sunniest days.

sections.title: Alternatives for Aft Deck
sections.intro: The modular nature of Axopars and our multi-platform approach enable you to customize your boat with an aft layout that suits your everyday needs. As standard, the Axopar 45 Cross Top comes with an Aft Sofa on the aft deck. The aft deck can also be equipped with an optional U-Sofa or an Aft Cabin.

technical_specifications.name: Hull design
technical_specifications.value: Twin stepped 22 degree V “Sharp entry hull”

standard_equipment.name: Wheelhouse / Cockpit
standard_equipment.description:
- Dual electrically operated canvas roofs with harbor cover.
- Upholstery in Silvertex Petrol with Seine piping.
- Foldable light mast in white painted aluminum with anchor light.
- Pilot and 2 x co-pilots seats with flip-up bolsters and swivel base with two large drawers and remote battery switches in seat base.
- Wide aft sofa with storage units.
- Wetbar with sink and faucet and a 65l drawer refrigerator.
- Upholstered, aft-facing sofa around wetbar.
- Wide, foldable hi-lo table between aft bench and wetbar.
- Recessed led roof lights and hidden speakers.
- Integrated windscreen wipers with separate reservoir.
- Grabrails along both sides of the roof.
- Clean helm layout with control switch panel in glass with illuminated push switches.
- Twin 12” Simrad glass bridge display.
- Intelligent steering module (ISM) steering wheel in leather with integrated controls for audio, trim tabs and bow thruster.
- Integrated windscreen wipers with separate reservoir.
- Lockable access hatch to front cabin with grab rail in leather.
- Fire and CO2 alarms.

standard_equipment.name: Hull and Deck
standard_equipment.description:
- Hand laminated hull in GRP with vinylester resin for the first coat for osmosis prevention.
- Vacuum infused stringers and 45” Twin-stepped hull with sharp entry bow, bow thruster, and integrated engine brackets for 3 x Mercury V8 300hp outboard engines.
- Trim tabs and underwater lights on transom.
- Axopar 3D signature chrome logo and openable balcony doors on both sides of hull.
- Hand laminated self draining walk around deck with anti-skid finishing and deck lights.
- All hardware, pulpits, side rails, high handled bathing ladder, telescopic bathing ladder, locks, hinges, filler caps, 8x cleats and cockpit grab rail in 316 stainless steel.
- Hooking points for safety harness and 2 large fender storages on the open aft deck and battery / electrical compartment underneath.
- Shower on aft deck.
- LED navigation lights in bow.
- Anchor hatch with shore power inlet connected to battery charger.
- Sofa on fore deck in Silvertex Petrol with Seine piping upholstery and harbor cover.
- Complete boat in Axopar white gelcoat.

standard_equipment.name: General
standard_equipment.description:
- Freshwater system.
- Fire and CO2 alarms.

standard_equipment.name: Front Cabin
standard_equipment.description:
- Elegant wish upholstered matrasses and cushions, interior panels in light oak, table tops in wenge colored wood.
- Queen sized bed which when flipped up transforms the separated sofas into a U-sofa.
- Upholstered roof and wall panels in modern felt material.
- 2 x roof mounted speakers.
- Gullwing doors.
- Sink and faucet, wardrobe, recessed led roof lights, reading lights and ambient lighting in roof and on floor.
- Fire and CO2 alarms.
- Carpet on floor and steps.
- Separate toilet compartment with toilet, mirror, cabinet, shower and sink.
- Freshwater system is included.
